versions.subject: fix: FPs
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /am51'
        - ' /password'
filter_fps:
    - CommandLine|contains: ' /PASSWORDCHG'  # net user
    - ParentImage:
        - 'C:\Program Files\CEETIS\CEETIS_IDE.exe'  # CEETIS from WEETECH
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\CEETIS\CEETIS_IDE.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("* /am51*", "* /password*") NOT (CommandLine="* /PASSWORDCHG*" OR ParentImage IN ("C:\\Program Files\\CEETIS\\CEETIS_IDE.exe", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\CEETIS\\CEETIS_IDE.exe"))
